notes: Library trustees' and (from 1932) Library Commission minutes 1919-1945, one volume (SFPL minutesofregular1119sanf) with poor OCR and gaps (no meetings found for much of 1932-34, 1937-38 and 1940-44). Re-read for the branch buildings: Anza (John Reid Jr., Frank J. Reilly, 1931), the WPA branches at West Portal and Bernal Heights (Frederick H. Meyer, 1936), and the January 1945 branch committee report on how each city-owned branch was paid for. Dated by the 'San Francisco, <date>' meeting header (early2.py); OCR'd years like 'I9I4.5' read by hand.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: the Glen Park branch at 700 Bosworth Street (opened January 3, 1927; gone), the Ingleside branch in the Masonic temple store at Ocean and Ashton (1925-26), the Parkside branch (rented store, 1935), the San Bruno district portable beside the Edward Robeson Taylor School (1926), the Phelan memorial room in the old Main Library (H. A. Thomsen, 1931). The meetings of 1932-34, 1937-38 and 1940-44, when Anza opened and the WPA branches were built and dedicated, are not in this volume's text.
coverage.note: Curated list F4.py; early.py and early2.py read the volume.
